evals.prompt: How do I render rich text from my content type? I have an Article with a body property that's richText type. I just want to display it on the page. Using Next.js 14 with the Optimizely SDK.
evals.expected_output: Should show importing RichText from '@optimizely/cms-sdk/react/richText'. Should demonstrate basic usage: <RichText content={content.body?.json} /> passing the .json property of the rich text field. Should wrap in a container with preview attributes using pa('body'). Should explain that .json is the structured representation used by the RichText component, not .html. Should show the complete component pattern with ContentProps typing, getPreviewUtils, and the RichText component inside a wrapper div.

evals.prompt: Some elements in my rich text aren't rendering at all. I'm using the RichText component and most content shows up fine but certain elements just disappear or show as plain text without any formatting. What's going on?
evals.expected_output: Should explain the fallback behavior: unknown or unrecognized element types render as <span> by default, which is a safe fallback but may appear as unstyled plain text. Should recommend checking the rich text JSON data to identify the element type names that are not rendering correctly. Should show how to add custom element handlers for those specific types using the elements prop. Should mention that content from the Integration API may contain unexpected element types since it bypasses editor validation. Should list the available element types (heading-one through heading-six, paragraph, quote, bulleted-list, numbered-list, link, table elements, code, pre, etc.) so the user can identify what they need to handle.
